item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no image was created.

Add credits, then I can retry the professional headshot edit: navy blazer, light blue shirt, neutral background, and softer lighting while preserving your natural appearance.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this photo into a photorealistic professional business headshot of the exact same man. Preserve his identity, facial structure, age, gray hair, natural skin texture and recognizable features. Replace the casual gray T-shirt with a well-fitted dark navy blazer over a crisp light blue collared shirt, open at the neck without a tie. Replace the kitchen with a clean neutral light gray studio background. Use soft flattering studio lighting, balanced exposure and natural colors. Head and shoulders composition, upright confident posture, approachable natural expression, eyes looking at the camera. Subtle realistic retouching only, no artificial smoothing, no text.
